def total : List ℤ := raw_ints% [5772841572902054667651146774199833959791862038062238105965610215076442686799273091581232558270767130881084752856506986620535659784017689325860669095610]
def normUpper : ℚ := ((577284157290205466765114677419983395979186203806223810596561021507644268679927309158123255827076713088108475285650698662053565978401768932586066909561 : ℚ)/14693679385278593849609206715278070972733319459651094018859396328480215743184089660644531250000000000000000000000000000000000000000)
def H : ℚ := ((577284157290205466779808356805261989828795410521501881569294340967295362698786705486603471570260802748753006535650698662053565978401768932586066909561 : ℚ)/14693679385278593849609206715278070972733319459651094018859396328480215743184089660644531250000000000000000000000000000000000000000)
def R : ℚ := ((78575847771744501760 : ℚ)/1)
def cs : List (ℤ × ℤ) := coefficients.map (fun a => (a,0))

theorem translation : (normalizedCoefficients.reverse.foldl (shiftStep (-8,0) 5) ([],1)).1=cs := by
  -- kcost: 8 s estimated;one degree130 Gaussian translation at a real center.
  decide +kernel
theorem norms : normsOK cs U=true := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;131 real Gaussian norm comparisons.
  decide +kernel
theorem sum_check : positiveHorner U 2 1=total.getD 0 0 := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;131 exact positive Horner stages.
  decide +kernel
theorem ellipse_check : normUpper+1 ≤ H ∧ H ≤ R ∧ H^2-1 ≤ (R-H)^2 := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;exact sharp Bernstein ellipse square witness.
  decide +kernel
theorem weighted_check : R^33*(4 : ℚ)^260*5^780 ≤
    (S1ExpLower.expLower.getD 0 0 : ℚ)*3^780 := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;one shared exponential lower witness, strongest segment target.
  decide +kernel
theorem scale_check : (total.getD 0 0 : ℚ) = normUpper*(scaleInt 5 : ℚ) := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;exact rational normalization of the total value witness.
  decide +kernel
theorem norm_bound (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc (((-1 : ℚ)/1) : ℝ) (((-3 : ℚ)/5) : ℝ)) :
    ‖complexP.eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ (normUpper : ℝ) := by
  have hc : castPair (-8,0)/(2*((5 : ℤ) : ℂ)) = ((-4/5 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> norm_num [castPair,Complex.div_re,Complex.div_im]
  have hx' : x ∈ Icc (-1/1 : ℝ) (-3/5 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Rat.cast_div,Rat.cast_ofNat,Rat.cast_neg,Rat.cast_one] using hx
  apply block_value_bound (radius := (1/5 : ℝ)) cs (-8,0) (q := 5) (by norm_num) translation U norms 2 1
    (total.getD 0 0) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) sum_check _ _ (x : ℂ) _
  · have hh := congrArg (fun x : ℚ => (x : ℝ)) scale_check
    push_cast at hh
    simpa only [Int.cast_one,one_pow,mul_one,one_mul] using hh.le
  · norm_num
  · rw [hc,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_eq_norm,← Complex.ofReal_sub,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs]
    push_cast
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor <;> linarith [hx'.1,hx'.2]
theorem segment_bound (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc (((-1 : ℚ)/1) : ℝ) (((-3 : ℚ)/5) : ℝ)) :
    (66 : ℝ)/130*ellipseLog (complexP.eval (x : ℂ))+
      8*Real.log ‖(1 : ℂ)-(x : ℂ)‖ ≤ (24330011831893/549755813888 : ℝ)+12*Real.log (3/5) := by
  have hB : (normUpper : ℝ)+1 ≤ (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ellipse_check.1
  have hHR : (H : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ellipse_check.2.1
  have hsq : (H : ℝ)^2-1 ≤ ((R : ℝ)-H)^2 := by exact_mod_cast ellipse_check.2.2
  have hp : (R : ℝ)^33*(4 : ℝ)^260*5^780 ≤
      (S1ExpLower.expLower.getD 0 0 : ℝ)*3^780 := by exact_mod_cast weighted_check
  apply real_segment_weight_le_of_power (v := complexP.eval (x : ℂ)) _ (norm_bound x hx)
    hB hHR hsq hp S1ExpLower.expLower_le
  have hx' : x ∈ Icc (-1/1 : ℝ) (-3/5 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Rat.cast_div,Rat.cast_ofNat,Rat.cast_neg,Rat.cast_one] using hx
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hx'.1],by linarith [hx'.2]⟩

def total : List ℤ := raw_ints% [2734665105699927502483537936411363764574573870144693662747174625143094051631713701747341957147280744685374237504988627331027331317845582995689874711626]
def normUpper : ℚ := ((1367332552849963751241768968205681882287286935072346831373587312571547025815856850873670978573640372342687118752494313665513665658922791497844937355813 : ℚ)/73468396926392969248046033576390354863666597298255470094296981642401078715920448303222656250000000000000000000000000000000000000000)
def H : ℚ := ((1367332552849963751315237365132074851535332968648737186237253909869802495910153832516072057289560820645909775002494313665513665658922791497844937355813 : ℚ)/73468396926392969248046033576390354863666597298255470094296981642401078715920448303222656250000000000000000000000000000000000000000)
def R : ℚ := ((37222332596335149056 : ℚ)/1)
def cs : List (ℤ × ℤ) := coefficients.map (fun a => (a,0))

theorem translation : (normalizedCoefficients.reverse.foldl (shiftStep (8,0) 5) ([],1)).1=cs := by
  -- kcost: 8 s estimated;one degree130 Gaussian translation at a real center.
  decide +kernel
theorem norms : normsOK cs U=true := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;131 real Gaussian norm comparisons.
  decide +kernel
theorem sum_check : positiveHorner U 2 1=total.getD 0 0 := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;131 exact positive Horner stages.
  decide +kernel
theorem ellipse_check : normUpper+1 ≤ H ∧ H ≤ R ∧ H^2-1 ≤ (R-H)^2 := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;exact sharp Bernstein ellipse square witness.
  decide +kernel
theorem weighted_check : R^33*(4 : ℚ)^260*5^780 ≤
    (S1ExpLower.expLower.getD 0 0 : ℚ)*3^780 := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;one shared exponential lower witness, strongest segment target.
  decide +kernel
theorem scale_check : (total.getD 0 0 : ℚ) = normUpper*(scaleInt 5 : ℚ) := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;exact rational normalization of the total value witness.
  decide +kernel
theorem norm_bound (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc (((3 : ℚ)/5) : ℝ) (((1 : ℚ)/1) : ℝ)) :
    ‖complexP.eval (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ (normUpper : ℝ) := by
  have hc : castPair (8,0)/(2*((5 : ℤ) : ℂ)) = ((4/5 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> norm_num [castPair,Complex.div_re,Complex.div_im]
  have hx' : x ∈ Icc (3/5 : ℝ) (1/1 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Rat.cast_div,Rat.cast_ofNat,Rat.cast_neg,Rat.cast_one] using hx
  apply block_value_bound (radius := (1/5 : ℝ)) cs (8,0) (q := 5) (by norm_num) translation U norms 2 1
    (total.getD 0 0) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) sum_check _ _ (x : ℂ) _
  · have hh := congrArg (fun x : ℚ => (x : ℝ)) scale_check
    push_cast at hh
    simpa only [Int.cast_one,one_pow,mul_one,one_mul] using hh.le
  · norm_num
  · rw [hc,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_eq_norm,← Complex.ofReal_sub,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs]
    push_cast
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor <;> linarith [hx'.1,hx'.2]
theorem segment_bound (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc (((3 : ℚ)/5) : ℝ) (((1 : ℚ)/1) : ℝ)) :
    (66 : ℝ)/130*ellipseLog (complexP.eval (x : ℂ))+
      8*Real.log ‖(1 : ℂ)-(x : ℂ)‖ ≤ (24330011831893/549755813888 : ℝ)+12*Real.log (3/5) := by
  have hB : (normUpper : ℝ)+1 ≤ (H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ellipse_check.1
  have hHR : (H : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ellipse_check.2.1
  have hsq : (H : ℝ)^2-1 ≤ ((R : ℝ)-H)^2 := by exact_mod_cast ellipse_check.2.2
  have hp : (R : ℝ)^33*(4 : ℝ)^260*5^780 ≤
      (S1ExpLower.expLower.getD 0 0 : ℝ)*3^780 := by exact_mod_cast weighted_check
  apply real_segment_weight_le_of_power (v := complexP.eval (x : ℂ)) _ (norm_bound x hx)
    hB hHR hsq hp S1ExpLower.expLower_le
  have hx' : x ∈ Icc (3/5 : ℝ) (1/1 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Rat.cast_div,Rat.cast_ofNat,Rat.cast_neg,Rat.cast_one] using hx
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hx'.1],by linarith [hx'.2]⟩
end Positive

theorem segment_bound (x : ℝ) (hx0 : (3/5 : ℝ) ≤ |x|) (hx1 : |x| ≤ 1) :
    (66 : ℝ)/130*ellipseLog (complexP.eval (x : ℂ))+
      8*Real.log ‖(1 : ℂ)-(x : ℂ)‖ ≤ (24330011831893/549755813888 : ℝ)+12*Real.log (3/5) := by
  have hx := abs_le.mp hx1
  by_cases hneg : x < 0
  · apply Negative.segment_bound x
    rw [abs_of_neg hneg] at hx0
    norm_num
    exact ⟨hx.1,by linarith⟩
  · apply Positive.segment_bound x
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt hneg)] at hx0
    norm_num
    exact ⟨hx0,hx.2⟩

theorem segmentPhi : ∀ κ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x : ℝ, (3/5 : ℝ) ≤ |x| → |x| ≤ 1 →
    nodalPhi dc72.toParameters green72 κ (x : ℂ) ≤ 72*omega72 κ := by
  intro κ hκ x hx0 hx1
  have hh := real_segment_phi_of_strong hκ.1 hx0 hx1 (segment_bound x hx0 hx1)
  rw [Real.log_abs] at hh
  have he : (Polynomial.aeval (x : ℂ)) realP = complexP.eval (x : ℂ) := by
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_def,Polynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map]
    rfl
  norm_num [nodalPhi,dc72,DesignConst.toParameters,green72,nodalGreen,omega72,circleCap72,
    Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [he]
  convert hh using 1 <;> ring

end
